tagline: Andaman's long-stay island - the southern node of the Phuket-Phi Phi-Krabi mesh.
summary: Ko Lanta (Krabi province) is the Andaman's largest long-stay resort island, sitting south of Phi Phi and Krabi on the same dense ferry web. It is a natural Andaman connected city to the Phuket flagship: crowded diesel ferries and speedboats already run Saladan to Phi Phi, Krabi and Phuket today, and a premium foiling tier removes the pounding and the monsoon cancellations that cap repeat ridership on a long-stay island.

demand_signals.detail: High-occupancy west-coast resort strip (Klong Dao, Long Beach, Kantiang) with long average stays and strong day-trip appetite.
Established Saladan ferry/speedboat market to Phi Phi, Krabi and seasonal Phuket - the upgrade target.
Ko Lanta is a primary launch point for Phi Phi and the southern Andaman marine parks.

use_cases: Ko Lanta <-> Phi Phi all-electric day-trip
Ko Lanta <-> Krabi/Ao Nang gateway transfer
Phuket <-> Ko Lanta long-stay resort run

journeys.note: Busiest Andaman island leg off Saladan.
Gateway transfer to the Krabi/Ao Nang mainland.
Southern Andaman flagship run; in Pioneer II range.

navier_fit: High as an Andaman connected city to the Phuket flagship. Clean Pioneer II legs (<=40 nm) across an already-dense ferry web with strong long-stay resort willingness-to-pay; foiling extends the comfortable-sea window on an island whose access is monsoon-throttled.
competitive_landscape: Dense crowded ferry/speedboat fleet (Saladan hub) with rough rides and frequent SW-monsoon cancellations; no premium on-demand tier.
seasonality: SW monsoon (May-Oct) brings rough southern-Andaman seas and reduced ferry frequency; high season Nov-Apr. Foiling extends the comfortable operating window.
regulatory_note: Thai Marine Department rules and Mu Ko Lanta / marine-park seasonal closures at established jetties.

precedents.label: Saladan Andaman ferry web
precedents.note: Existing high-volume Phi Phi/Krabi/Phuket demand a premium foiling tier upgrades.

grab.wedge: Premium long-stay-island water tier extending the Phuket Andaman flagship south.
